card.name: Words right before the word rate
card.fires_on: Words in a phrase where the next word is likely 'rate' or 'rates', such as cure, graduation, completion, success, or discontinuation. Also fires on small words like 'in' or 'at the' when a rate is expected.

modes.label: Outcome noun before rate
modes.description: A noun naming an outcome that is followed by 'rate', often after a percentage.
modes.example: The procedure has been proven to have a >94%<< cure>> rate when performed by an experienced specialist.

modes.label: Linking word predicting a rate
modes.description: A small word or gap where the sentence is heading toward 'rate' or a percentage figure.
modes.example: blacks turned out at<< the>> same rate as whites for the first time

card.writes: It pushes the model to output 'rate' or 'rates' next.
card.plain: It lights up when the next word is likely to be 'rate', as in success rate or graduation rate.
